faq.answer: We're open Tuesday to Sunday, 7am to 4pm. Orders placed after 2pm are delivered the next morning.
We're at 12 Harbour Street. You can also collect your order from the shop counter.
We deliver within 5 miles of the shop for a flat £3.50. Delivery usually takes about an hour.
Our kitchen handles gluten, dairy, eggs and nuts. The sourdough is vegan. Ask us about any specific allergy before ordering.
After you confirm your order, we send a secure Stripe checkout link. You can pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
